name: /qiskit_machine_learning/qiskit_machine_learning.neural_networks.EstimatorQNN
summary: A quantum neural network based on the Estimator primitive that computes expectation values of observables as outputs, supporting forward passes and gradient backpropagation for variational training.
docstring: EstimatorQNN computes expectation values of a parameterized quantum circuit evaluated with an Estimator primitive. Inputs are encoded via a feature map part of the circuit; weights are the trainable parameters.

name: /qiskit_machine_learning/qiskit_machine_learning.neural_networks.SamplerQNN
summary: A quantum neural network based on the Sampler primitive that maps circuit measurement probability distributions to output values via an interpret function, enabling classification and generative tasks.
docstring: SamplerQNN samples from a parameterized quantum circuit and applies an interpret function to the resulting probability distribution.

name: /qiskit_machine_learning/qiskit_machine_learning.neural_networks.NeuralNetwork
summary: Abstract base class for all quantum neural networks, defining the forward and backward interface for expectation-value and sampling-based QNNs.
docstring: Base class for quantum neural networks in Qiskit Machine Learning.

name: /qiskit_machine_learning/qiskit_machine_learning.neural_networks.EffectiveDimension
summary: Computes the global effective dimension of a quantum neural network as an information-geometric measure of the model's expressive power and trainability.
docstring: EffectiveDimension evaluates the Fisher information matrix of a QNN to compute the effective dimension.

name: /qiskit_machine_learning/qiskit_machine_learning.neural_networks.LocalEffectiveDimension
summary: Computes the local effective dimension of a quantum neural network around specific weight values, measuring model capacity at a given parameter point.
docstring: LocalEffectiveDimension evaluates the effective dimension of a QNN at specified parameter values.

name: /qiskit_machine_learning/qiskit_machine_learning.algorithms.classifiers.NeuralNetworkClassifier
summary: A scikit-learn-compatible quantum classifier that wraps any NeuralNetwork and trains it via a loss function to perform binary or multi-class classification.
docstring: NeuralNetworkClassifier takes a NeuralNetwork and trains it as a classifier using gradient-based optimization.

name: /qiskit_machine_learning/qiskit_machine_learning.algorithms.classifiers.VQC
summary: A Variational Quantum Classifier that combines a feature map for data encoding and a parameterized ansatz circuit optimized to perform supervised classification.
docstring: VQC encodes classical data into a quantum state via a feature map, then uses a variational ansatz whose parameters are optimized for classification.

name: /qiskit_machine_learning/qiskit_machine_learning.algorithms.classifiers.QSVC
summary: Quantum Support Vector Classifier that uses a quantum kernel (fidelity between feature-map-encoded states) as the kernel function for a classical SVM.
docstring: QSVC extends scikit-learn SVC with a quantum kernel computed from the inner product of quantum feature-map states.

name: /qiskit_machine_learning/qiskit_machine_learning.algorithms.classifiers.PegasosQSVC
summary: Quantum Support Vector Classifier based on the Pegasos online optimization algorithm, using a quantum kernel for stochastic gradient SVM training with improved scaling.
docstring: PegasosQSVC implements the Pegasos algorithm for quantum kernel SVM, iteratively updating the model using sampled training points.

name: /qiskit_machine_learning/qiskit_machine_learning.algorithms.regressors.NeuralNetworkRegressor
summary: A scikit-learn-compatible quantum regressor that wraps any NeuralNetwork and trains it to predict continuous-valued outputs.
docstring: NeuralNetworkRegressor takes a NeuralNetwork and trains it as a regressor by minimizing a loss function.

name: /qiskit_machine_learning/qiskit_machine_learning.algorithms.regressors.VQR
summary: A Variational Quantum Regressor that uses a feature map and trainable ansatz circuit to fit continuous-valued target functions.
docstring: VQR is the regression counterpart of VQC, using variational optimization of a quantum circuit to predict real-valued outputs.

name: /qiskit_machine_learning/qiskit_machine_learning.algorithms.regressors.QSVR
summary: Quantum Support Vector Regressor that uses a quantum kernel function in a classical SVR framework for regression tasks.
docstring: QSVR extends scikit-learn SVR with a quantum kernel computed from quantum feature-map state fidelities.

name: /qiskit_machine_learning/qiskit_machine_learning.kernels.FidelityQuantumKernel
summary: Quantum kernel that computes the inner product between pairs of quantum states prepared by a feature map circuit, using the compute-uncompute (Hadamard test) method.
docstring: FidelityQuantumKernel evaluates K(x,y) = |<phi(x)|phi(y)>|^2 using a StateFidelity primitive.

name: /qiskit_machine_learning/qiskit_machine_learning.kernels.FidelityStatevectorKernel
summary: Statevector-based quantum kernel that computes exact fidelities between feature-map-encoded states for kernel machine learning.
docstring: FidelityStatevectorKernel computes quantum kernels exactly via statevector simulation without shot noise.

name: /qiskit_machine_learning/qiskit_machine_learning.kernels.TrainableFidelityQuantumKernel
summary: A trainable quantum kernel whose feature map contains free parameters that are optimized to align the kernel with training labels, combining kernel methods with variational training.
docstring: TrainableFidelityQuantumKernel extends FidelityQuantumKernel with trainable parameters in the feature map.

name: /qiskit_machine_learning/qiskit_machine_learning.kernels.TrainableFidelityStatevectorKernel
summary: Statevector-based trainable quantum kernel combining exact fidelity computation with variational optimization of feature map parameters.
docstring: TrainableFidelityStatevectorKernel is a statevector-simulated trainable quantum kernel.

name: /qiskit_machine_learning/qiskit_machine_learning.kernels.algorithms.QuantumKernelTrainer
summary: Trains a quantum kernel by optimizing its free parameters to maximize kernel-target alignment on labeled training data, using a variational optimizer.
docstring: QuantumKernelTrainer optimizes the parameters of a TrainableFidelityQuantumKernel using a variational loss.

name: /qiskit_machine_learning/qiskit_machine_learning.circuit.library.qnn_circuit
summary: Constructs a QNN circuit by composing a data-encoding feature map and a trainable ansatz, and returns the input and weight parameters separately.
docstring: qnn_circuit produces a QuantumCircuit = feature_map + ansatz, with input parameters from the feature map and weight parameters from the ansatz.

name: /qiskit_machine_learning/qiskit_machine_learning.circuit.library.RawFeatureVector
summary: A parameterized circuit that directly encodes a feature vector into the amplitude vector of a quantum state via an Isometry, implementing amplitude encoding.
docstring: RawFeatureVector encodes n-dimensional classical data into log2(n) qubits using amplitude encoding.

name: /qiskit_machine_learning/qiskit_machine_learning.circuit.library.raw_feature_vector
summary: Function form of RawFeatureVector: creates a parameterized amplitude encoding circuit for a classical feature vector.
docstring: raw_feature_vector creates an amplitude-encoding circuit for a given feature dimension.

name: /qiskit_machine_learning/qiskit_machine_learning.connectors.TorchConnector
summary: Bridges a Qiskit NeuralNetwork to PyTorch by wrapping it as a torch.nn.Module, enabling hybrid quantum-classical training with PyTorch optimizers and autograd.
docstring: TorchConnector makes a QNN available as a PyTorch module for use in hybrid classical-quantum neural network architectures.

name: /qiskit_machine_learning/qiskit_machine_learning.gradients.ParamShiftEstimatorGradient
summary: Computes gradients of expectation values with respect to circuit parameters using the parameter-shift rule for gradient-based variational optimization.
docstring: ParamShiftEstimatorGradient applies the parameter shift rule to compute analytic gradients of expectation values.

name: /qiskit_machine_learning/qiskit_machine_learning.gradients.ParamShiftSamplerGradient
summary: Computes gradients of sampler probability distributions with respect to circuit parameters using the parameter-shift rule.
docstring: ParamShiftSamplerGradient applies the parameter shift rule to compute gradients of probability distributions.

name: /qiskit_machine_learning/qiskit_machine_learning.gradients.LinCombEstimatorGradient
summary: Computes expectation value gradients using the linear combination of unitaries method, an alternative to the parameter-shift rule for variational optimization.
docstring: LinCombEstimatorGradient uses the linear combination method to compute analytic gradients.

name: /qiskit_machine_learning/qiskit_machine_learning.gradients.LinCombSamplerGradient
summary: Computes probability distribution gradients using the linear combination of unitaries method.
docstring: LinCombSamplerGradient computes gradients of probability distributions via linear combination of unitaries.

name: /qiskit_machine_learning/qiskit_machine_learning.gradients.SPSAEstimatorGradient
summary: Estimates expectation value gradients using the Simultaneous Perturbation Stochastic Approximation method, a noise-robust alternative to parameter-shift for noisy hardware.
docstring: SPSAEstimatorGradient uses the SPSA finite-difference method to estimate expectation value gradients.

name: /qiskit_machine_learning/qiskit_machine_learning.gradients.SPSASamplerGradient
summary: Estimates probability distribution gradients using SPSA, useful for noise-robust variational optimization on quantum hardware.
docstring: SPSASamplerGradient uses SPSA to estimate gradients of probability distributions.

name: /qiskit_machine_learning/qiskit_machine_learning.gradients.QFI
summary: Computes the Quantum Fisher Information matrix of a parameterized quantum circuit, used to characterize the trainability and natural gradient of variational algorithms.
docstring: QFI computes the quantum Fisher information matrix for a parameterized quantum circuit.

name: /qiskit_machine_learning/qiskit_machine_learning.gradients.LinCombQGT
summary: Computes the Quantum Geometric Tensor using the linear combination of unitaries method, providing curvature information for Riemannian optimization of variational circuits.
docstring: LinCombQGT computes the quantum geometric tensor which generalizes the QFI.

name: /qiskit_machine_learning/qiskit_machine_learning.algorithms.inference.QBayesian
summary: Quantum Bayesian inference algorithm that encodes a Bayesian network as a quantum circuit and uses rejection sampling or direct querying to compute posterior probabilities.
docstring: QBayesian implements quantum-accelerated inference on probabilistic graphical models encoded as quantum circuits.

name: /qiskit_machine_learning/qiskit_machine_learning.state_fidelities.ComputeUncompute
summary: Computes the fidelity between two quantum states by preparing the first state, applying the inverse of the second, and measuring the probability of the zero state (compute-uncompute method).
docstring: ComputeUncompute implements the Hadamard test / compute-uncompute circuit to estimate state fidelity.
